instagram:
Patient record management breaks down at one question in the OPD: "Did you bring your old reports?" Usually the answer is a folder at home, so the doctor rebuilds the history from what the patient remembers.

FineHealth by Fine Solves keeps reports in one patient record, next to registration, OPD and IPD visits, prescriptions and GST-ready billing. It is cloud-hosted, so the record opens the same at the front desk and in the consultation room.

How often does a follow-up visit at your hospital start without the old reports?
